verdict.rationale: An email service could plausibly ship a built-in assistant that connects to external MCP servers, so this axis applies to Fastmail. The evidence pack covers only the JMAP API, API tokens, push and standard mail features, with no mention of an MCP client, an AI assistant, or any way to plug in MCP servers. Probes for machine-readable docs (llms.txt, OpenAPI) also returned 404, so there is no support for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
